research_onboarding_assignments:
CREATE TABLE `research_onboarding_assignments` (
  `student_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `approved_by_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `assignment_json` longtext NOT NULL,
  `state` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `project_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`student_id`),
  KEY `onboarding_admin_fk` (`approved_by_user_id`),
  KEY `onboarding_project_fk` (`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `onboarding_admin_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`approved_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `onboarding_project_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `research_projects` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `onboarding_student_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `students` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `onboarding_assignment_json` CHECK (json_valid(`assignment_json`)),
  CONSTRAINT `onboarding_assignment_state` CHECK (`state` in ('pending','review','activated','cancelled'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
research_project_protocols:
CREATE TABLE `research_project_protocols` (
  `project_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `protocol_code` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`project_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `protocol_code` (`protocol_code`),
  CONSTRAINT `protocol_project_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `research_projects` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
